purpose: Convert repeated steering and recovery guidance into deterministic workflow checks and explicit evidence lanes.

operatingContract.dependencyRule: Do not start a downstream implementation slice until the upstream receipt validator passes.

signals.feedback: Repeated requests to try again or continue after the baseline handoff.
signals.rootFailure: The workflow had no durable continuation checkpoint, so the next agent turn had to reconstruct branch, worktree, PR, dirty-state, and next-action truth from conversation context.

durableImprovement.prevention: Require a structured continuation checkpoint with branch, SHA, dirty-state, dependency, blockers, and exact validation evidence before a lane may resume.

proof.expectedBehavior: The gate fails when a checkpoint field, claim lane, or signal remediation is missing.

signals.feedback: A parallel Astro check/build attempt raced on the shared generated .astro directory and had to be rerun serially.
signals.rootFailure: The validation strategy optimized for parallelism without a generated-state isolation contract.

durableImprovement.prevention: Declare portfolio validation execution serial; generated-state checks must not be fanned out unless each command has an isolated output directory.

proof.expectedBehavior: The gate fails if validationExecution is changed from serial without an explicit isolation rule.

signals.feedback: The repository's untrusted mise shim repeatedly prevented the canonical wrapper from resolving its pinned Node tool, while direct npm binaries passed.
signals.rootFailure: Runtime selection and repository command contracts were coupled to an untrusted shim without a structured blocked-runtime classification.

durableImprovement.prevention: Classify untrusted-shim failures as blocked_runtime, record the resolved executable paths, and route validation through a repository-owned direct-runtime wrapper before claiming a source failure.
durableImprovement.followUp: Add scripts/run-portfolio-validation.sh with an explicit direct-runtime resolution policy before the next release gate.

proof.expectedBehavior: The gate requires a proposed recovery handler to include an explicit follow-up instead of silently treating the runtime blocker as fixed.
